evidence.claim: NG EIA-storage announcement-day premium decayed; absent 2014-2018
evidence.quote: "the effect is not present in the most recent period (2014–2018), which saw a sharp decline in energy prices"
evidence.source: Prokopczuk, Wese Simen, Wichmann (2021), Energy Journal 42(2), doi:10.5547/01956574.42.2.mpro, https://centaur.reading.ac.uk/90003/

evidence.claim: Same: pre-announcement part halved after 2014
evidence.quote: "the preannouncement effect has been even stronger in the past with average values of −0.38% and −0.47% for the first and second period, respectively. However, it has more than halved to only −0.15% in the most recent period after 2014."
evidence.source: same

evidence.claim: Same: strategy net of costs no longer pays
evidence.quote: "In the more recent period, this has declined to only 3% and a Sharpe ratio of 0.5, which do not withstand transaction and funding costs."
evidence.source: same

evidence.claim: Same: the whole day effect sits in the 2-hour window around the release
evidence.quote: "the entire effect (99%) stems from the two hour window surrounding the announcement"
evidence.source: same

evidence.claim: Weather-forecast NG premium is a 5-day NG1/NG2 spread, gross
evidence.quote: "Simulation based on daily NYMEX futures settlement prices, 4 April 1990 to 31 July 2019, without considering transaction costs and market slippage."
evidence.source: Monteux, Arcuri, Gandolfi, Caselli (2025), NAJEF 80, 102494, doi:10.1016/j.najef.2025.102494

evidence.claim: Same: realized-weather surprise is absorbed intraday the next day (contemporaneous, no lead)
evidence.quote: "when these forecasts are wrong, the market updates NG1 prices in the intraday trading session the following day"
evidence.source: same

evidence.claim: Same: the forecast archive used is the free NOAA GEFS Reforecast V2 (fixed 2012 model), from Dec 1984
evidence.quote: "The forecast data used in this study corresponds to the Reforecast V2 dataset, which consists of an 11-member ensemble of forecasts, produced every day from 00:00 UTC initial conditions from Dec 1984 to the present."
evidence.location: Section 3 (data), lines 355-358 of the text copy
evidence.source: same

evidence.claim: Newest weather paper: NG prices move with forecast revisions (contemporaneous price discovery), asymmetric
evidence.quote: "weather forecasts and forecast revisions, rather than realized weather conditions, exert significant effects on natural gas prices. We further document a pronounced asymmetry in market responses"
evidence.source: Hsu, Park, Zhu (2026), "Weather Forecasts, Forecast Revisions, and Natural Gas Price Discovery", SSRN wp, doi:10.2139/ssrn.6985300 (also 10.2139/ssrn.7411255)

evidence.claim: WPSR-day third half-hour predicts last half-hour in crude (USO)
evidence.quote: "returns on the third half-hour on EIA announcement days can significantly and positively predict the returns in the last half-hour"
evidence.source: Wen, Indriawan, Lien, Xu (2023), Energy Journal 44(4), doi:10.5547/01956574.44.4.zwen
evidence.grade: peer-reviewed [secondary-only for this run: abstract via Crossref]

evidence.claim: NG pre-release informed trading driven by forecasting skill; strategy Sharpe 1.26
evidence.quote: "A simple trading strategy conditioned on the predictor would have generated an annualized Sharpe ratio of 1.26."
evidence.source: Gu, Kurov (2018), J. Futures Markets 38(9), doi:10.1002/fut.21926

evidence.claim: Sequential API->EIA announcements: crude inefficiency; predictor of surprises and pre-announcement returns in and out of sample
evidence.quote: "We also construct a predictor that can predict inventory surprises and preannouncement returns in‐sample and out‐of‐sample."
evidence.source: Alturki, Kurov (2021), J. Futures Markets, doi:10.1002/fut.22264

evidence.claim: HFTs in first 50 ms earn most NG storage-report profits; no pre-release informed trading found
evidence.quote: "those who trade within the first 50 ms accurately incorporate the information contained in the storage report into prices, and earn the majority of profits"
evidence.source: Brigida, Pratt (2019), Studies in Economics and Finance, doi:10.1108/sef-03-2018-0092

evidence.claim: Crowd (free) NG storage forecasts add nothing beyond the professional consensus
evidence.quote: "crowdsourced consensus forecast does not influence the market’s expectation of gas storage changes beyond what is already contained in professional consensus forecast"
evidence.source: Fernandez-Perez, Garel, Indriawan (2020), Energy Journal 41(5), doi:10.5547/01956574.41.5.afer

evidence.claim: Market impounds analyst storage forecasts before the EIA release; storage surprises partly reverse next week
evidence.quote: "the market promptly incorporates analyst forecasts into oil and gas prices prior to the EIA announcements"
evidence.source: Ederington, Lin, Linn, Yang (2019), Energy Journal 40(5), doi:10.5547/01956574.40.5.lede

evidence.claim: USDA releases: low-latency traders earn excess profits; lockup change did not remove them
evidence.quote: "excess profits can be earned quickly in agricultural commodity futures markets around United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) statistical releases"
evidence.source: Huang, Serra, Garcia (2022), AJAE, doi:10.1111/ajae.12356
